root_idea.summary: A root principle of inclination or deviation in a thing, especially a slanting or distortion of the neck, cheek, or course.
root_idea.development: The physical notion of bodily obliquity extends to turning the cheek away in pride and to related descriptions of oblique movement, twisting, and contracted or rounded forms.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Normalized from the Quranic imperfect form تُصَعِّرْ to the Form II perfect dictionary citation form صَعَّرَ.

senses.definition: To turn away one's cheek or face from people through pride or contempt.
senses.usage_conditions: A Form II construction involving the cheek or face; the Quranic usage describes deliberately turning it away from people because of arrogance, pride, or dislike.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have a wryness or distortion of the cheek, face, or neck; of a camel, to suffer a disorder that twists and distorts the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The distortion may be associated with pride in a person, or with a physical disorder in an animal; it may be natural or accidental.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat صَعَارِير, identified here as gum.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate lexical use recorded for the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone or something to acquire a wryness or distortion of the neck, with the face turned to one side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The distortion is caused by something striking or befalling the subject, rather than being the deliberate proud gesture of the Quranic construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To distort one's cheek through pride.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive Form V use describing the proud facial posture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of camels, to go at a vehement pace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IX use specifically attested with camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of camels, to become dispersed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative lexical interpretation of the same Form IX expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something round; to roll it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reduplicated special-form usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become round; to roll.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive or intransitive reduplicated special-form usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To writhe and turn around in place from pain, becoming contracted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a subject that has been beaten or struck; an alternative form incorporates the ن into the following ر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wryness or distortion of the face, cheek, or neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the legal expression فِي الصَّعَرِ الدِّيَةُ, it denotes facial distortion treated as an injury.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pride or being proud.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun referring to the proud disposition associated with turning away or facial distortion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Smallness of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person's head; the associated verb describes the head as being small.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece or strand of gum, especially gum that is long, slender, twisted, or concrete.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural صَعَارِيرُ may denote concrete gum resembling fingers; the term is also extended to gum generally in the cited evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hard fruit or similar hard growth, such as the fruit of a tree likened to the abhal or to pepper.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural صَعَارِيرُ may be used for such hard fruits or comparable hard objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thick, tough, somewhat soft and moist substance issuing from the teat; especially the first or gummy milk of the colostrum.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparison-based extension of the noun صُعْرُورٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The little ball rolled along by a dung beetle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for the rounded object made and moved by the beetle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Long fingers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended plural usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Proud or haughty; one who turns away the face from people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use associated with declining the cheek and withdrawing from others through pride; the cited traditional wording has variant reports.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Large, great, and round, especially of a camel's hump.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to the size and rounded form of a camel's hump.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intensely red.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression أَحْمَرُ صَيْعَرِيٌّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Obliquity in going, marching, or course.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun derived from the notion of صَعَرٌ as bodily or directional obliquity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mark made with a hot iron on a camel's neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Some authorities describe it particularly as a mark on a she-camel, while its application to a male camel is disputed in the cited discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a wryness or distortion of the cheek, face, or neck; of a camel, having a disorder that twists the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The condition may be natural or accidental and is explicitly applied in the evidence to people, an ostrich, and camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Withdrawn or self-important through pride; figuratively, one who turns away from the truth and is faulty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in traditional expressions as a figurative extension of turning away the face.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hard or severe, of a night-journey to water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used specifically of a demanding journey in the cited poetic expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made round; round.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of rounded objects, illustrated by round pepper grains.
